title: Scattering in Quantum Graphs with Scale-Invariant Vertex Couplings: Resonances, Gaps and (Quasi-)Periodic Transmission
summary: We study scattering on quantum graphs that consist of a channel with periodically attached resonators under scale-invariant vertex couplings. For this model, we derive explicit formulas for the transmission probability and analyse how it depends on the geometric and coupling parameters.
